newsitem.title: DUBAI: Bulls push Oman's share index to record highs.
newsitem.headline: Bulls push Oman's share index to record highs.

text.p: Oman's share index moved into record territory in the week to Wednesday buoyed by brisk trade and higher bids for most shares listed on the official bourse, the Muscat Securities Market said.
It said the index breached the 200-point barrier for the first time since the market was set up in 1989, ending 4.8 points higher at 200.34 points from 195.53 points a week earlier.
Of the 55 companies traded in the week, shares of 26 rose, 13 fell, and 16 were unchanged.
A total of 4.60 million shares changed hands compared to the previous week's 4.78 million shares.
The banking and investment sector accounted for 74 percent of total trading value of 11.4 million rials ($30 million).

Among major gainers were Oman National Bank which closed firmer at 3.590 rials from 3.410, and Oman International Development and Investment Company which ended at 3.180 rials from 3.010 rials a week earlier. ($1=0.377 rials) -- Dubai Newsroom 9714-626990
